body:
CONTEXT
ROADMAP.md L44-46: "- loop: clean first round, converge after 1 fix, no-progress, ceiling, fixer error with partial changes (rollback), fixer timeout, no-diff; both working-tree and branch scope / - exit codes for every row above". L26-34: the checkpoint and rollback mechanisms (stash; `reset --hard` + `clean -fd`) are unchanged by the plan (R4). R4 L395-401: "NOTHING in this plan changes `updateStashCheckpoint`, `restoreFromStash`, `buildRecoveryCmd`, `spawnFixer`, the SIGINT handlers, or the branch-scope reset/clean; the parity suite pins all of them." R1 L216-226: in --loop the empty exit applies ONLY to the initial round; an empty context after a fix is reviewed as today and reaches `clean` with normal review_result/loop_end/loop_summary; "a parity row covers a fixer that empties the diff, with and without `--fail-on-empty`". L104-107: "with `--loop-unsafe-allow-fix-secrets` the fixer's stdin contains the unmasked token; without it, the placeholder." L84-87: in step 1 a loop review failure still prints to stderr and exits 1 with NO terminal events (delta 24 adds them). R4 L404-421: today the working-tree loop reviews untracked files but cannot fix or checkpoint them; a loop whose changes are ALL untracked aborts with 'Failed to create stash checkpoint'; delta 25 replaces those rows. L1235: every loop line validated against the event schema. L459-461: delta 18 adds `--loop-accept-rollback-limits` to these rows' invocations, so every loop invocation is built by ONE helper per file. A2 (delta 2, L634-636): `--timeout` becomes the reviewer budget only and the fixer gets its own default/`--loop-fixer-timeout`, so rows relying on fixer budget = timeout*2 (src/loop.js L985 working tree, L1518 branch) change under delta 2.

Code under test (read only): src/loop.js runLoop ~L871-1368 (fixer detect, probeOsConstraint, provider config, fix-secrets check ~L953-985, loop_start ~L998-1007, SIGINT ~L1015-1031, initial empty ~L1062-1071, secret scan ~L1075-1082, review failure exits ~L1109/~L1148 with no events, clean/no-progress/ceiling ~L1180-1223, stash checkpoint ~L1225-1240, fix event ~L1305-1311, fixer error/timeout + restoreFromStash ~L1314-1346, no-diff ~L1350-1356); runBranchLoop ~L1400-1759 (clean-tree precondition ~L1404-1414, detached HEAD ~L1418-1421, empty check ~L1577, scan ~L1588, review failure ~L1611/~L1640, finish(), SIGINT, reset --hard + clean -fd ~L1704-1716 and ~L1748, fix_committed ~L1754); redactSecretsInFindings ~L359-372 (placeholder `[REDACTED: contains likely secret (<pattern>)]`); buildRecoveryCmd ~L185-196; buildLoopSummary ~L166-182.

HARNESS CONTRACT (from T50): defineRows/row() with per-file manifests; fresh config per run; unexpected stub requests get 418; withMutant requires a unique `find` (several loop strings repeat: e.g. `gitRun(cwd, ["clean", "-fd"])` occurs at ~L1711 and ~L1748 and `Review failed:` 4 times, so include surrounding lines); fixer mocks' `--version` probes are recorded separately and do not consume responses.

FIXTURES
- Reviewer: anthropic API stub (`--provider anthropic`) unless a row says otherwise; fixer: `codex` mock auto-detected (detectFixer order codex -> claude -> agy). Every loop invocation is built by `loopArgs(scope, extra = [])` defined once per file, returning `--loop --loop-unsafe` (+ `--scope branch --base main` for br) + `--json` unless the row is a human-output row, + extra.
- Working-tree repo: tracked code.js modified (no untracked files unless the row says so). Branch repo: `main` baseline, `feature` with one commit modifying code.js, clean tree.
- Findings must cite code.js so the fixer is offered it.

ROWS (`<s>` = wt and br; wt rows in loop-working-tree.test.mjs, br rows in loop-branch.test.mjs, scope-independent rows and NEG rows in loop-common.test.mjs)
  LOOP-CLEAN-<s>: round-1 APPROVE -> exit 0; event types in order loop_start, review, review_result, loop_end{exitReason clean, iterations 0}, loop_summary{verdict approve, survivingCount 0, acceptedCount 0}; zero fixer calls; git state unchanged (wt: same diff, empty stash list; br: HEAD unchanged).
  LOOP-CONVERGE-<s>: round-1 FLAG, fixer writes a fix to code.js, round-2 APPROVE -> exit 0, iterations 1; wt: stash_created then fix with filesModified [] (verified live on 2.11.1: code.js was already dirty before the fix, and diffedFiles reports only status lines that are NEW after the fix, so an already-modified file is not listed; LOOP-HUMAN-wt correspondingly prints 'Files modified: (none)'), final tree contains the fixer's edit, stash list empty after the clean exit; br: fix_committed whose commit's parent is beforeFixHead, HEAD advanced by one commit, tree clean.
  LOOP-NOPROG-<s>: round-2 returns the byte-identical gating finding -> exit 2, loop_end exitReason no-progress, loop_summary survivingCount 1. wt: loop_end carries matchedIteration 1 and stashRef. br: loop_end carries NO matchedIteration (only the working-tree path sets it, src/loop.js runLoop no-progress branch) and carries originalHead.
  LOOP-CEIL-<s>: `--loop-max 1`, round-2 returns a gating finding with different file/line/title, clearly dissimilar text -> exit 2, exitReason ceiling.
  LOOP-FIXERR-<s>: fixer writes a partial edit to code.js and creates new.txt, then exits 3 -> exit 2, exitReason fixer-error; wt: code.js restored via restoreFromStash (new.txt remains: R4 limit 4); br: HEAD == beforeFixHead, code.js restored, new.txt removed; stderr 'Fixer exited with code 3'.
  LOOP-FIXTIMEOUT-<s>: `--timeout 1` (fixer budget = timeout*2 s, src/loop.js L985 / L1518), fixer sleeps 30 s -> exit 2, exitReason fixer-timeout, stderr 'Fixer timed out'; rollback as in FIXERR.
  LOOP-NODIFF-<s>: fixer exits 0 without changes -> exit 2, exitReason no-diff.
  LOOP-EMPTY-<s> / LOOP-EMPTY-FOE-<s>: empty initial scope -> review_result null + loop_end clean + loop_summary, exit 0; with --fail-on-empty -> loop_end exitReason empty, exit 1; zero reviewer and fixer calls.
  LOOP-FIXER-EMPTIES-<s> / LOOP-FIXER-EMPTIES-FOE-<s>: round-1 FLAG, the fixer reverts code.js to baseline -> the post-fix empty context is reviewed as today (no empty exit even with --fail-on-empty), clean with normal events; exit 0 both. Pin exactly what v2.11.0 emits, review-call count included.
  LOOP-REVIEW-FAIL-<s>: reviewer stub returns non-JSON twice in round 1 -> exit 1, stderr 'Review failed', stdout contains ONLY loop_start.
  LOOP-SECRET-<s>: diff contains an AKIA token, no --allow-secrets -> exit 1, secret message on stderr, zero reviewer calls, no terminal events.
  LOOP-MULTI-<s>: `--providers anthropic,openai --quorum 1 --loop-fixer claude` (anthropic stub; openai family resolves to the codex mock as reviewer; a claude mock is the fixer, so reviewer and fixer binaries differ), round-1 FLAG from both, fix, round-2 APPROVE -> exit 0; loop_summary.providers == ["anthropic","openai"] (confirm labels from a run).
  LOOP-FIXSECRETS-ON-<s> / LOOP-FIXSECRETS-OFF-<s>: reviewer = openai API stub (`--provider openai`, OPENAI_API_KEY + OPENAI_BASE_URL) so the provider check (~L966-982; FIXER_PROVIDER_MAP L245 maps codex to openai) passes for the codex fixer. Both rows use the same reviewer/fixer pair. Under R1 (ROADMAP R1 family normalization; C3 'R1's normalization is authoritative') the openai stub reviewer has a custom base URL (OPENAI_BASE_URL), so its family is UNKNOWN and, with B = {openai} (the codex fixer), its independence is null, not false. So the delta-1 migration (T80) must add `--allow-unverified-independence` to both rows, and FIXSECRETS-ON also `--allow-same-family` (T86 AC9: fix-secrets now requires it); FLAG finding `body` contains an `sk-` token (diff clean). ON (`--loop-unsafe-allow-fix-secrets`): fixer's recorded stdin contains the raw token; OFF: contains `[REDACTED: contains likely secret (` and not the token.
  LOOP-HUMAN-<s>: LOOP-CONVERGE without --json -> exit 0, stdout has the per-round human report and no line parses as an object with `type`; stderr has the success line.
  LOOP-SIGINT-<s>: fixer applies a partial edit, touches its marker, then blocks on a FIFO handshake (T50 AP8 `waitFifo`, no sleep); the harness's signalAfter waits for the marker, sends SIGINT, then releases the FIFO -> exit 1, stderr 'Interrupted.'; wt: stderr contains the recovery command (match by regex, buildRecoveryCmd); partial edit NOT rolled back (R4 limit 3); br: HEAD unchanged, partial edit present.
  LOOP-WT-UNTRACKED-MIXED: working-tree loop with a tracked change plus an untracked file -> pin today's outcome (untracked content reaches the reviewer prompt; the fixer prompt offers tracked files only).
  LOOP-WT-UNTRACKED-ONLY: all changes untracked, FLAG in round 1 -> exit 1, stderr 'Failed to create stash checkpoint'.
  LOOP-BR-DIRTY: branch scope with an uncommitted change -> exit 1, stderr 'requires a clean working tree', stdout empty, zero calls.
  LOOP-BR-DETACHED: detached HEAD -> exit 1, stderr 'HEAD is detached', no events.
Every --json row: assertValidEvents on every stdout line; every row asserts exit code, stub.unexpected empty, and fixer/reviewer invocation counts. loop_summary and other event assertions check NAMED fields only, never the full key set (so later schema extensions are absorbed by the schema file, but the rows still list the deltas below because their validated output changes).

FUTURE DELTAS (manifest futureDeltas)
- Every loop row: 1 (`--builder human`) and 18 (`--loop-accept-rollback-limits` via loopArgs).
- Every --json loop row that reaches loop_summary: 21 (`validated` on loop_summary) and 8 (meta on loop_summary in step 3).
- Every --json loop row whose stream carries a `review_result` with at least one finding (LOOP-CONVERGE-<s>, LOOP-NOPROG-<s>, LOOP-CEIL-<s>, LOOP-FIXERR-<s>, LOOP-FIXTIMEOUT-<s>, LOOP-NODIFF-<s>, LOOP-FIXER-EMPTIES-*, LOOP-MULTI-<s>, LOOP-FIXSECRETS-*, LOOP-SIGINT-<s>, LOOP-WT-UNTRACKED-*): 15 (A9 makes per-finding `verification_status` required in the round result; T94 AC11 edits these rows).
- LOOP-FIXTIMEOUT-<s>: 2 (after A2 the row sets `--loop-fixer-timeout 1`). LOOP-SIGINT-<s> does not depend on the fixer budget (it blocks on a FIFO, not a sleep) and does not list 2. Per T50 AP8, `sleep` is used only by LOOP-FIXTIMEOUT-<s>, and no row combines sleep with signalAfter.
- PAYLOAD DELTAS (T50 AP1 and AP3; prompts and requests are compared fields). A row 'reaches a provider' when it makes at least one non-probe reviewer or fixer mock invocation or stub request. 9 on every WORKING-TREE row that reaches a provider (the review payload becomes one combined diff; branch-scope payloads are unchanged, so branch rows never list 9). 14 on every row with at least one stub request. 31 on every row that reaches a provider. Rows that exit before any call (for example a loop secret refusal) list none of 9, 14 or 31.
- 39 (loop filesModified reports every content change, T118): every WORKING-TREE row whose run emits a fix event or prints a "Files modified:" line (for example LOOP-CONVERGE-wt, whose filesModified becomes ["code.js"], and LOOP-HUMAN-wt). Branch rows never list 39 (a branch loop starts from a clean tree, so no file is already dirty).
- LOOP-NOPROG-<s>, LOOP-CEIL-<s>: 4. LOOP-REVIEW-FAIL-<s>: 24. LOOP-SECRET-<s>: 17, 24. LOOP-FIXSECRETS-ON-<s>: 26 (also exploit_scenario), and the step-3 `--allow-unverified-independence --allow-same-family` additions (covered by 1). LOOP-FIXSECRETS-OFF-<s>: 26, and the step-3 `--allow-unverified-independence` addition (covered by 1; its custom-base openai stub reviewer is unknown family, so null against the codex fixer under R1). The same holds for EVERY T54 loop row whose reviewer is an API stub: under delta 1 the stub reviewer is unknown family and the loop refuses (null) unless T80 adds `--allow-unverified-independence` or switches the row to a known-family CLI mock reviewer (e.g. `--provider claude` mock with the codex fixer); T80 chooses at its P1, and either way the edit is covered by tag 1. Both LOOP-FIXSECRETS-* rows also list 16: their reviewer finding carries an `sk-` token, and T65's loop emission switch (decisions Q4) masks it in their `review_result` events. LOOP-HUMAN-<s>: 21 (success wording). LOOP-WT-UNTRACKED-*: 25 (and 5 for untracked bytes). LOOP-MULTI-<s>: 12.

- DELTA TAGS FOR v59 DELTAS (T50 registry, test/parity/helpers/deltas.mjs; tag semantics T50 item 9b): ids come from the registry T50 lands on day one (1-37, withdrawn ids rejected). Never 28 or 37: both are UNTAGGABLE (28 pins v2.11.0 behavior; J9.4 forbids any existing row listing 37), and the T50 checks reject them. 34 and 35: not for the additive loop_summary keys meta.thrash and meta.rotation:null, which are the T50 envelopes of those deltas. 36: only for a row that asserts stderr EXACTLY (equality, emptiness) on a detecting run, which must use assertStderrExact; the T50 helper throws until such a row lists 36, so the tag cannot be forgotten. Substring checks (assertStderrIncludes / assertStderrExcludes) need no 36: the one-line hint is the delta-36 envelope. 32 and 33: only if the row's invocation is one delta 32 rejects, or its pinned CLI retry timing is one delta 33 changes (none planned; T91 adds its own CLIERR-UNIT-BUDGET row). Delta 35 (D8 'Parity': a loop row is edited for 35 only if its auto-selected pool has two or more providers): every T54 single-reviewer row PINS its reviewer with `--provider` (anthropic, or openai for FIXSECRETS; D8: '--provider X pins one reviewer'), and LOOP-MULTI-<s> uses `--providers`, which D8 excludes; so rotation never activates and none lists 35. A T54 row that plants two or more permitted reviewer candidates without pinning (--provider) must list 35 (house rule 9). T97's AC0 audit and its capture-compare --delta 35 gate re-check this at T97.

BASELINE: rows pin what release 2.11.1 emits (v2.11.0 plus the #66 fix, which also corrected the first path in loop filesModified, so fix events now report full paths). Cited line numbers are approximate; locate code by symbol. Cite the ROADMAP by section heading. Rows use the T50 harness under its approved spec (.adlc/specs/T50.md): defineRows, captures with prompts and requests (AP1), type+ordinal event pairing (AP5), FIFO handshakes and no CI skips (AP8), assertValidEvents from T51, and manifest entries { roadmapRef, futureDeltas }.

P0 RESOLUTIONS (2026-10-07)
- LOOP-MULTI uses `--loop-fixer claude` with a claude mock fixer, so reviewer and fixer binaries differ. The R1 consequences arrive with delta 1 (tag 1) and are handled by T80/T86.
- LOOP-FIXER-EMPTIES rows pin whatever 2.11.1 does for a post-fix empty working tree, oddities included. Parity records behavior, it does not judge it.
- SIGINT rows use T50 AP8's FIFO handshake (deterministic, no sleep, never skipped on CI).

FIXTURE NOTES (from live verification on 2.11.1, 2026-10-07)
- The codex REVIEWER mock in LOOP-MULTI must write its review JSON to the path after `--output-last-message`, or the CLI treats the codex pass as failed (ENOENT on its out file). The T50 harness codex mock does this by default.
- LOOP-FIXSECRETS-* rows use the openai API stub reviewer as specified; the live check used a claude CLI reviewer and confirmed only the token and placeholder behavior at the fixer's stdin.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
AC1  Every row above is registered via row() and present in its manifest with the futureDeltas above. Verified by the T50 registry hooks and `node --test test/parity/harness.test.mjs`, plus a loop-common.test.mjs test asserting every loop manifest entry lists 1 and 18, every LOOP-FIXTIMEOUT-* lists 2, every LOOP-FIXSECRETS-* lists 16 and 26, every --json row reaching loop_summary lists 21 and 8, every --json row whose review_result carries a finding lists 15, every working-tree row that reaches a provider lists 9 and no branch row lists 9, every row with a stub request lists 14, every row that reaches a provider lists 31, every working-tree row with a fix event or a Files-modified line lists 39 and no branch row lists 39, and no row lists 28, 34, 35, 37 or 38 (negative control: the same assertion function reports an injected manifest row listing 35).
AC2  All rows pass on unmodified 2.11.1. Verified by `node --test test/parity/loop-working-tree.test.mjs test/parity/loop-branch.test.mjs test/parity/loop-common.test.mjs`.
AC3  Every NDJSON line from every --json loop row validates via assertValidEvents. Verified by AC2 and `grep -c assertValidEvents` non-zero per loop file.
AC4  Single loop-flag builder: a test in loop-common.test.mjs reads each loop-*.test.mjs source, counts matches of /["'`]--loop["'`]/ and asserts exactly 1 per file, located between `function loopArgs(` and the end of that function; negative control: the same counter applied to a fixture string with two occurrences reports 2. The fixture string is built by concatenation (e.g. `'"--' + 'loop"'`) so that loop-common.test.mjs itself still counts exactly 1. Verified by AC2.
AC5  Mutant negative controls (withMutant, unique finds), each asserting the targeted row FAILS: (a) restoreFromStash body made a no-op -> LOOP-FIXERR-wt fails; (b) the fixer-failure `gitRun(cwd, ["clean", "-fd"]);` at ~L1711 removed (find must include the preceding `Fixer failed — discarding its partial changes` log line for uniqueness) -> LOOP-FIXERR-br fails (new.txt remains); (c) buildLoopSummary verdict forced to "approve" -> LOOP-NOPROG-wt fails; (d) redactSecretsInFindings returns its input unchanged -> LOOP-FIXSECRETS-OFF-wt fails; (e) emit a loop_end event before the exit in the working-tree SINGLE-reviewer review-failure catch at L1147-1150 (the path LOOP-REVIEW-FAIL-wt takes: a fresh `--provider anthropic` config is not `_fromCache`, so the round runs `result = await reviewRound(reviewConfig);` at L1145; L1109 is the MULTI path and is never reached by this row). The find must be unique: `result = await reviewRound(reviewConfig);` + `} catch (err) {` + the `Review failed:` line + `if (stashRef) log.warn(buildRecoveryCmd(stashName));` (the branch twin at L1637-1641 uses `recoveryLine`) -> LOOP-REVIEW-FAIL-wt fails. Verified in `[row:NEG-LOOP-*]` rows in loop-common.test.mjs.
AC6  Git-state assertions use gitState() (HEAD, parent, status porcelain, stash list, file contents) and never timestamps or stash names verbatim (stash names embed Date.now(), ~L988-989); recovery-command assertions match by regex. Verified by AC2 and AC7.
AC7  Determinism: `for i in 1 2 3; do node --test test/parity/loop-*.test.mjs || exit 1; done` passes; SIGINT and timeout rows each complete within 60 s.
AC8  No production or rail change: `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- bin src schema.json output-schema.json loop-events-schema.json test/parity/helpers test/parity/harness.test.mjs test/parity/schemas.test.mjs` empty. Verified by that command and rails-guard.

NON-GOALS
- No delta behavior: no --loop-accept-rollback-limits, no untracked refusal, no review-error events, no `validated`, no meta, no exploit_scenario redaction, no --loop-fixer-timeout.
- No change to the checkpoint/rollback mechanisms (R4).

VERIFICATION COMMAND
node --test test/parity/*.test.mjs && npm test && git diff --exit-code HEAD -- bin src schema.json output-schema.json loop-events-schema.json test/parity/helpers
title: Parity rows: --loop in working-tree and branch scope (terminal states, rollback, events, git state, SIGINT) against 2.11.1 (ROADMAP step 0)
